regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Keep French /b/ and /v/ distinct
lessons.objective: Hear and produce the French /b/ and /v/ difference in a restaurant conversation.
lessons.focus: French b and v represent distinct sounds. Close both lips for /b/ in beau and bateau; use the lower lip against the upper teeth for /v/ in vin and veau.

words.fr: Le vase est sur la table.
words.en: The vase is on the table.

words.fr: Je voudrais du veau, s'il vous plaît.

reader.fr: Nous déjeunons près de la rivière et voyons un beau bateau.
reader.en: We have lunch near the river and see a beautiful boat.

reader.fr: Un vase est posé sur notre table.
reader.en: A vase is set on our table.

reader.fr: Je commande du veau et mon ami choisit du vin.
reader.en: I order veal and my friend chooses wine.

reader.fr: À la fin du repas, il dit : « Ce vin est bon. »
reader.en: At the end of the meal, he says, 'This wine is good.'

speaking.opening: Bonjour, je voudrais du veau, s'il vous plaît.
speaking.closure: Merci, le bateau est beau et le vin est bon.

see.prompt: Sort bateau, beau, bon, vin, veau, and vase by initial /b/ or /v/.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for boat before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for beau or veau in the recorded sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The boat is beautiful.'

say.prompt: Order veal politely, keeping the initial /v/ distinct.
say.answerRef: Je voudrais du veau, s'il vous plaît.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences describing the boat and your restaurant order.

lessons.title: Contrast /t/ and /d/ at a café
lessons.objective: Keep French /t/ and /d/ distinct in words for a café meeting and in short requests.
lessons.focus: Compare tasse, table, and thé with dame, date, and demain. The tongue makes a brief contact near the upper front teeth; the vocal folds distinguish /d/ from /t/.

words.fr: La tasse est sur la table.
words.en: The cup is on the table.

reader.fr: Une dame attend à la table près de la fenêtre.
reader.en: A woman waits at the table near the window.

reader.fr: Elle demande une tasse de thé.
reader.en: She asks for a cup of tea.

reader.fr: Nous choisissons une date pour notre prochaine rencontre.
reader.en: We choose a date for our next meeting.

reader.fr: Elle propose demain, et je suis d'accord.
reader.en: She suggests tomorrow, and I agree.

goals: Ask for a cup of tea.
speaking.closure: Très bien, on se voit demain.

see.prompt: Sort tasse, table, thé, dame, date, and demain by initial /t/ or /d/.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for tomorrow before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for tasse or date in the recorded café sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The cup is on the table.'
type.answerRef: La tasse est sur la table.

say.prompt: Ask which date works for your friend.

write.prompt: Write a short French exchange setting a date and ordering tea.

lessons.title: Carry /d/ through connected French phrases
lessons.objective: Keep /d/ audible in French words and short connected phrases while exchanging an address and directions.
lessons.focus: Say adresse, idée, détail, and demander within whole phrases. Keep /d/ as part of the word; do not add a vowel after it or replace it with an English-style flap.

words.fr: Donnez-moi votre adresse, s'il vous plaît.
Pouvez-vous me donner plus de détails sur le trajet ?
words.en: Can you give me more details about the route?

words.fr: J'ai une idée pour vous aider.
words.en: I have an idea to help you.
Can you give me the address?

reader.fr: Je demande une adresse à l'agent d'accueil.
reader.en: I ask the reception agent for an address.

reader.fr: L'agent me donne l'adresse et un détail sur le trajet.
reader.en: The agent gives me the address and a detail about the route.

reader.fr: J'ai une idée pour aider mon ami à trouver la rue.
reader.en: I have an idea to help my friend find the street.

reader.fr: Je lui donne l'adresse et nous partons ensemble.
reader.en: I give him the address and we leave together.

speaking.scene: Asking a reception agent for an address
goals: Ask one detail about the route.
Repeat the address to a friend.
speaking.closure: Merci, j'ai l'adresse et le détail.

see.prompt: Locate written d and spoken /d/ in adresse, idée, détail, aider, donner, and demander.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for address before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for adresse or détail in the recorded direction request.

type.prompt: Type the French question for 'Can you give me the address?'

say.prompt: Ask the agent for more details about the route.
say.answerRef: Pouvez-vous me donner plus de détails sur le trajet ?

write.prompt: Write two French sentences asking for an address and offering an idea to help.
